variants.headline: Still in view: grant programme passes over needy districts
variants.sub: Districts in need were passed over by a government grant programme.
variants.body:
A government grant programme has passed over districts that needed it. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The gazette records the omission of districts in need without supplying the programme's terms or a motive for its allocation. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
